bio.text: Kerri Evelyn Harris represents the 32nd District in the Delaware House of Representatives, with legislative service beginning in 2022, and serves as House Majority Leader.
Harris is a veteran of the U.S. Air Force who served during the Iraq War.

sources.title: Rep. Kerri Evelyn Harris, House Majority Leader, District 32
